title: get_research_report output
description: Stored report fields plus markdown body, user- or system-authored only; never external text (MCP-041). Every output carries env, tier, as_of_utc and health (MCP §4.0). No C4 data ever; the login only hashed (MCP-040). Errors use the generic MCP-042 shape, which is outside this schema.

anyOf.description: Tier of the report's results, if any.

health.description: Aggregate health at as_of_utc, so stale or unhealthy data is never mistaken for live (MCP §4.0).

params.description: FIXTURE when fixture parameters are in effect (RISK-066).

fields.description: The report's structured fields. Shape not specified.

markdown_body.description: Markdown body, control characters stripped, length-capped (MCP-041).

content_origin.description: MCP-041 content_origin. The spec says 'user- or system-authored' but spells only mcp_client as a value.
